paper_title: CodeRAG-Bench Can Retrieval Augment Code Generation
caption: Performance with different chunking sizes.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of four different code retrieval sources—Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files—as a function of the number of tokens used for chunking. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Tokens," ranges from 200 to 800 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 200. The y-axis, which represents performance (though not explicitly labeled), ranges from 10 to 40 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 10. The blue line with circular markers (Tutorials) starts at approximately 23 at 200 tokens, increases to about 28 at 800 tokens, and then slightly declines. The red line with circular markers (Library Documentation) begins at around 26 at 200 tokens, rises to approximately 32 at 800 tokens, and then decreases to about 28. The yellow line with circular markers (StackOverflow posts) starts at approximately 34 at 200 tokens, decreases steadily to about 18 at 800 tokens, and continues to drop to around 12. The green line with circular markers (Github files) begins at approximately 28 at 200 tokens, increases to about 33 at 800 tokens, and then slightly decreases to around 30. All lines are solid and marked with circular data points at each token interval.
